messages:
Alex Park: Morning — wrapping up the SI "skill lanes" micro-cert path. Need alignment on three things: 1) labship (hardware allocation + booking cadence), 2) marketplace listing timing and collateral, 3) trainer certification format (hands-on vs. proctored). I've uploaded the rough cadence doc here: https://redwood.internal/si-skill-lanes/cadence — can folks ✅ the timelines?

Maria G: looked — two quick asks: add SIs to the private repo before week 1 (so they can run prework), and we need an NDA checklist for hardware vendors. also we should lock in trainer exam pass criteria (not just completion).

Samir R: hardware q — are we using H100 reserved racks or shared A100s for the lab days? counts? Also who on Partnerships is owning crate pickup with NimbleHW?

Alex Park: plan is H100s for the instructor-led lab weeks (latency-sensitive demos) and A100s for async practice. target: 4 H100 sessions per cohort (2 days each) + continuous A100 sandbox. I'll follow up with infra for exact node counts. @Samir R — want you to own NimbleHW logistics?

Samir R: I can take NimbleHW logistics. Need vendor contact and shipping SLA. pinging @Maria G for NDA on vendor side.

Jen O'Neill: calendar note — Solutions Eng team headcount is tight in April. Suggest pushing cohort start by one week unless we can get two fractional trainers. Also need a short checklist for trainers (VM access, proctoring link, grading sheet).

Priya S: marketplace-bot: Draft listing uploaded to staging marketplace (internal link): https://marketplace.staging/redwood/si-skill-lanes. Included: one-pager, instructor bio template, and offer SKUs (trial sandbox, paid cohort). Need PR review and legal.

Alex Park: nice — can the marketplace team hold a 30m review on Wed? I pushed a PR to the collateral repo: https://git.redwood/si-skill-lanes/collateral — reviewers: @Priya S, @Maria G, @Jen O'Neill.

marketplace-bot: Reminder: marketplace listing auto-validate run succeeded for metadata, failed for images (403).

Maria G: I'll fix images and update the NDA checklist. Also want a short rubric for practical labs — suggest pass threshold 75% across three core tasks. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

Samir R: 75% seems fair. For the hands-on tasks we should snapshot KV cache performance tests and a sample regression prompt set. I'll draft tasks.

Jen O'Neill: Question: do we require SIs to pass the proctored exam before public marketplace listing, or can they be "certified provisional" (marketplace badge but probationary)? I prefer provisional for the first two cohorts to accelerate go-to-market.

Alex Park: provisional badge makes sense for cohorts 1-2 with clear renewal rules at 60 days. We'll add language to listing and partner agreement.

Priya S: Sales ops flagged pricing confusion — we need SKU mapping in the marketplace doc for trial vs paid seats (and a clear upgrade path). I'll add a matrix.

Alex Park: operational tasks checklist (quick):
- Samir: vendor contact + shipping SLA (due EOD Tue)
- Maria: NDA + image fixes + rubric (due Wed)
- Jen: trainer checklist + proctoring flow (due Wed)
- Priya: SKU matrix + PR review (due Thu)
If any blockers hit, call out here.

Samir R: noted — I'll open a runbook issue and paste vendor contact.

marketplace-bot: infra-provisioner: training-env provisioning scheduled for 2026-04-02 09:00 UTC.

Jen O'Neill: thumbs up on provisional. One more thing — can we record the labs and create a short 12-min highlight reel for each skill lane for marketing? @Priya S wanna own? :film_projector:

Priya S: I can own highlight reels. Will scope with Growth once cohorts are locked.

Alex Park: perfect. Last call: anyone see major risk with this plan? If not I'll send a consolidated runbook and announce the pilot to SIs tomorrow. :rocket: 

Maria G: no blockers from my side.

Samir R: no further risks.

Jen O'Neill: good to go from Eng.

Priya S: green.

Alex Park: sweet — I'll publish the runbook and PR the marketplace copy. Thanks all! :raised_hands:
